## 2. Mathematical Specification

Variables:
- \( f(t) = \sum_{k} c_k e^{2\pi i k t / L} \) for t=0..n-1, L fundamental period
- Coefficients \( c_k \) evolving under conserved dynamics
- Autocorrelation \( R(\tau) = \sum_t f(t) f(t+\tau) \)

Objective:
\( \text{AC1}(f) = \frac{2n \max_\tau R(\tau)}{(\sum f(t))^2} \)

Constraints:
- \( f(t) \in [0, 1000] \forall t \)
- \( \sum f(t) \geq 0.01 \) (satisfied via scaling)
- 3809-dimensional space

2. Maximize accumulation of low-frequency components while maintaining positive Fourier coefficients
